take_homes: Default to one agent. Split only for access, dialect or stance, and ask whether one prompt would do the same job.
Handoffs between agents are where numbers get lost or smoothed over, so check the seams.
The agent audit checks process, not whether the answer is true. Someone still has to verify the result.

monday.move: Ask my controller to try month-end variance commentary with one agent, not several, on non-sensitive data.
monday.when: After IT clears the tool, probably within a few weeks
monday.stop_condition: No time saved against the manual version, or any figure the agent can't trace to its source
monday.blocker: IT hasn't approved the tool for finance data, and nobody gave me a cost per user

misconception.why: The day never gave a price or a payback. The 'don't split unless you must' message helps me judge purchases, but I still treat AI as a licence plus some tuning. 'The organisation builds the capability' was not demonstrated.

one_line: Good rule: use one agent unless there is a reason to split. But I spent an afternoon on six agents and ended with an answer nobody can verify and no figure for the board.
